title: 第六十二章 农耕第六十一章 拒绝牙骨尔
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 隔着遥远的马车距离，孟婵玥看到昭武帝身着玄色龙纹亲耕礼服，腰系缀着东珠的玉带，身旁的于皇后一身青衣翟衣，鬓边只簪了一支白玉桑枝簪，帝后二人坐着玉辇驶出皇宫的时候，千余名文武百官与内外命妇早已沿着御道整齐列队，空气里都飘着春日的清润香气。
御驾行至皇城城南的藉田时，晨雾刚刚散尽。这片被特意划出来的千亩公田早已收拾妥当，田埂边立着刻满农桑祷文的汉白玉石碑，旁边的祭坛上整整齐齐摆着太牢祭品，司农寺的官员捧着木质犁具，躬身候在田边。礼部的礼官见帝后抵达，立刻挥动手中的拂尘，清亮的唱喏声顺着风传出去老远：“吉时到，陛下亲耕，祈岁丰穰！”
昭武帝缓步走到田边，身旁的内侍连忙上前要替他扶住犁柄，却被他抬手轻轻拦住。他伸手握住那柄缠着明黄绫布的犁，指尖稳稳落在冰凉的梨木柄上，按照古制扶犁三推，犁铧破开松软的黑土，翻出一道带着潮气的新垄。身后紧随的仲太傅，于太保等人依次推着犁走完完整的三圈，田埂边围观的百姓发出阵阵山呼万岁的声响，人群挤得满满当当。
不远处的亲桑苑里，于皇后正领着一众公卿命妇行亲桑之礼。苑中的桑树刚抽出嫩绿色的新叶，于皇后手持金钩，提着素白的桑筐，率先走到最粗壮的那株桑树下，亲手采下三条鲜嫩的桑叶，轻轻放进筐中。
身后的仲妃和钱妃、长公主萧文嫣依次上前采桑，再往后是诰命夫人们按品级采桑。孟婵玥手里提着一个小竹篮，与赵玉燕和楚青霜跟在那些命妇后面，伸手掐了几片小桑叶放进竹篮里。
她知道她们采下的桑叶被立刻送到一旁的蚕室，交给专门的蚕妇喂养蚕，待到结茧之后，这些蚕丝会被送入皇家织造坊，专门用来织造祭祀宗庙的祭服。
这时候，田边响起乐声，孟婵玥扭头去看。她看到两位穿着青布短打的老农被特意请到御前，昭武帝亲自接过他们递来的稻种，弯腰撒进刚刚翻好的土垄里。他直起身时，指尖沾了点湿润的泥土，对着身旁的司农卿朗声说道：“农为天下之本，朕今日亲耕这一亩田，便是要让天下人知晓，朕与万民同守稼穑之艰，共盼五谷丰登。”
于皇后采完桑后又走回昭武帝身旁，她的髻边沾了一小片桑叶，昭武帝抬手替她摘下来。
孟婵玥看着这一幕，想起自己在南梁时，她的父皇带着母妃一起在桃花林里赏花的一幕。当时有一朵花瓣落在母妃的发髻上，她的父皇很是温柔地将那片花瓣摘了下来，她朝他们喊了一声，两人站在桃花盛开的地方，一起扭头朝她笑……
“三公主，赵公主，皇后娘娘有请。”
就在这时，耳边响起一道轻柔的声音，孟婵玥回过头，看到喊自己名字的，似乎是于皇后宫女的宫女。
“两位公主随奴婢来。”
那位宫女微微颔首，领着两人往不远处的行宫走去。
孟婵玥和赵玉燕跟着引路宫女的脚步走进行宫时，发现殿内已经立着五位面熟的贵女。她们个个脸颊泛红，眼尾的余光时不时瞟向上首的方向，似乎很是害羞的模样。
孟婵玥的目光飞快地扫过上首的位置，于皇后依然穿着石青色织金翟衣，鬓边那支白玉桑枝簪还是方才亲桑时戴的那支，瞧着温和又端庄。她身侧坐着的仲妃穿一身水碧色罗裙，眉眼弯弯的。另一边的钱妃面色稍冷些，指尖漫不经心地摩挲着茶盏的边缘。
“见过皇后娘娘，仲妃娘娘，钱妃娘娘。”孟婵玥和赵玉燕一起上前，规规矩矩地行礼。
“平身。”于皇后笑着抬手，声音温和，目光落在孟婵玥和赵玉燕身上时，带着毫不掩饰的欣赏：“两位公主姿容不凡，怪不得去了一趟赏梅宴就有人给陛下呈上了求娶奏折。”
话音刚落，殿内站着的五位贵女脸颊更红了几分，头垂得更低了。孟婵玥心里透亮，应该是有人把求娶她的折子递到了御前，这五位贵女和赵玉燕都跟她一样。
“只是，在本宫看来，这姻缘一事讲求你情我愿，若是你们对求娶你们的世家公子不满意，尽管跟本宫说。”于皇后端起手边的茶盏抿了一口，语气松快：“三公主，赵公主，陛下还跟本宫说，你们俩大老远从故土来到大昭，本就受了不少委屈，终身大事自然要顺了自己的心意才好。”
孟婵玥和赵玉燕相视一眼，连忙再次福身应下。
一旁的钱妃见孟婵玥和赵玉燕表情紧绷，忍不住笑着插话：“皇后娘娘最是心善，前几日我娘家侄儿还跟我念叨，说赏梅宴上见着一位姑娘，想直接求陛下赐婚。我可是直接拒绝了，我说得先问问人家姑娘的心意呢。”
这话一出，殿内紧绷的气氛瞬间散了大半，连仲妃的嘴角都勾起点浅淡的弧度。
于皇后这才看着赵玉燕道：“赵公主，仲妃娘家的侄儿，世子仲唯行求娶你，不知你可愿意。”
赵玉燕忍住喉咙间的痒意，苍白无力的脸上泛起红晕：“全凭皇后娘娘做主。”
“这是愿意了……”于皇后闻言，忍不住笑起来。
坐在一旁的仲妃脸上却没多少喜色，方才孟婵玥和赵玉燕一起走进来，她一眼就看上了容貌更为精致的孟婵玥，至于看起来病歪歪的赵玉燕根本没有入她的眼。没想到，她那个侄儿看上的人竟然是个病美人，这让她无法高兴起来。
得到赵玉燕肯定的答复，于皇后心情大好，随后将目光投向一旁平静如波的孟婵玥。
“三公主，本宫这里有两本求娶你的奏折，一本来自国师，另一本来自本宫的侄儿于伯远。”
此话一出，殿内的众人都朝孟婵玥看了过去。
孟婵玥垂在身侧的手不由攥紧，庄拓求娶她，她不意外，只是，怎么又多了一个于伯远。
钱妃盯着孟婵玥看了一会儿，笑道：“南梁三公主如此绝色，难怪能吸引国师和于世子！”
content_en:
Across the distance of the carriage, Meng Chanyue saw that Emperor Zhaowu was wearing a black dragon-patterned plowing dress, with a jade belt decorated with dongzhu around his waist. Beside him, Queen Yu was dressed in a green Zhai robe, with only a white jade mulberry hairpin on her temples. When the emperor and the empress drove out of the palace in a jade chariot, more than a thousand civil and military officials and domestic and foreign ladies had already lined up neatly along the royal road, and the air was filled with the fresh fragrance of spring.
When the imperial driver arrived at Zuotian in the south of the imperial city, the morning fog had just cleared. This specially designated 1,000 acres of public land has been cleared away. There is a white marble stone tablet engraved with Nongsang prayers on the edge of the field. Tailao sacrifices are neatly placed on the altar next to it. Officials from Sinong Temple are holding wooden plows and waiting at the edge of the field. When the official of the Ministry of Rites saw the emperor's arrival, he immediately waved the fly whisk in his hand, and the clear singing sound carried far away along the wind: "The auspicious time has come, your majesty will plow the land personally, and pray for a good harvest!"
Emperor Zhaowu walked slowly to the edge of the field. The servant beside him quickly stepped forward to hold the plow handle for him, but he raised his hand and gently stopped him. He reached out and grasped the plow wrapped with bright yellow silk cloth. His fingertips rested firmly on the cold pear wood handle. He pushed the plow three times according to the ancient style. The plowshare broke through the soft black soil and turned out a new moist ridge. Following closely behind him were Taifu Zhong, Taibao Yu and others who pushed the plow for three complete turns. The people watching on the edge of the field let out bursts of cheers, and the crowd was packed to the brim.
In the mulberry garden not far away, Queen Yu was leading a group of ministers and wives to perform the mulberry ceremony. The mulberry trees in the garden had just sprouted new tender green leaves. Empress Yu, holding a golden hook and a plain white mulberry basket, took the lead to walk to the strongest mulberry tree, plucked three fresh mulberry leaves with her own hands, and gently put them into the basket.
Behind them, Concubine Zhong, Concubine Qian, and the eldest princess Xiao Wenyan stepped forward to pick mulberries in turn, followed by Mrs. Gaoming to pick mulberries according to grade. Meng Chanyue was holding a small bamboo basket in her hand. She, Zhao Yuyan and Chu Qingshuang followed the married women, reached out and pinched a few small mulberry leaves and put them into the bamboo basket.
She knew that the mulberry leaves they picked were immediately sent to the silkworm room nearby and given to specialized silkworm women to feed the silkworms. After the cocoons were formed, the silk would be sent to the royal weaving workshop to weave sacrificial garments for the ancestral temple.
At this time, music sounded from the edge of the field, and Meng Chanyue turned to look. She saw two old farmers in green cloth shorts specially invited to the imperial court. Emperor Zhaowu personally took the rice seeds from them and bent down to scatter them into the newly plowed soil ridges. When he straightened up, his fingertips were dipped in some wet soil, and he said loudly to Si Nongqing beside him: "Farming is the foundation of the world. I am plowing this acre of land today to let the people of the world know that I and all the people are guarding the hardships of harvesting and hoping for a good harvest."
…
After Queen Yu finished picking mulberries, she walked back to Emperor Zhaowu. There was a small piece of mulberry leaf on the edge of her bun, and Emperor Zhaowu raised his hand to pick it off for her.
Meng Chanyue looked at this scene and remembered the scene when her father and mother and concubine were admiring flowers in the peach blossom forest when she was in Nanliang. At that time, a petal fell on the concubine's hair, and her father gently picked off the petal. She called out to them, and they stood where the peach blossoms were in full bloom, turning to smile at her...
"Third Princess, Princess Zhao, the Queen has invited you."
At this moment, a soft voice sounded in her ears. Meng Chanyue turned around and saw that the person calling her name seemed to be the maid of Queen Yu.
"The two princesses are here with the slaves."
The palace maid nodded slightly and led the two of them to the palace not far away.
When Meng Chanyue and Zhao Yuyan walked into the palace following the footsteps of the leading ladies, they found five familiar-looking ladies already standing in the palace. Their cheeks were all red, and from the corner of their eyes they glanced upward from time to time, seeming to be very shy.
Meng Chanyue's eyes quickly glanced at the upper position. Queen Yu was still wearing an azure-colored gold-woven Zhai garment. The white jade mulberry branch hairpin on her temples was the same one she had worn when she had just kissed her. She looked gentle and dignified. Concubine Zhong, who was sitting next to her, was wearing an aqua skirt and had curved eyebrows. On the other side, Concubine Qian's face was slightly colder, and her fingertips carelessly rubbed the edge of the tea cup.
"I've seen the Queen, Concubine Zhong, and Concubine Qian." Meng Chanyue and Zhao Yuyan stepped forward together and saluted politely.
"Ping Shen." Queen Yu raised her hand with a smile, her voice was gentle, and when her eyes fell on Meng Chanyue and Zhao Yuyan, she said with undisguised admiration: "The two princesses are extraordinary in appearance. No wonder someone presented a marriage proposal memorial to Your Majesty after a plum blossom appreciation banquet."
As soon as he finished speaking, the cheeks of the five noble ladies standing in the hall turned redder and their heads lowered. Meng Chanyue knew clearly that someone should have handed the invitation to marry her to the emperor. These five noble ladies and Zhao Yuyan were all the same as her.
"It's just that, from my point of view, this marriage is a matter of your own free will. If you are not satisfied with the young master from an aristocratic family who wants to marry you, just tell me." Queen Yu took a sip from the teacup in her hand and said in a relaxed tone: "Third Princess, Princess Zhao, Your Majesty also told me that you two have come all the way from your homeland to Jokhang, and you have suffered a lot of grievances. Naturally, your life-long events must go according to your own wishes."
Meng Chanyue and Zhao Yuyan looked at each other and hurriedly agreed again.
Seeing the tense expressions of Meng Chanyue and Zhao Yuyan on the side, Concubine Qian couldn't help but smile and interjected: "The Queen is the most kind-hearted. A few days ago, my natal nephew even told me that he saw a girl at the plum appreciation banquet and wanted to directly ask His Majesty for marriage. But I refused directly. I said I had to ask the girl's feelings first."
As soon as these words came out, most of the tense atmosphere in the palace dissipated in an instant, and even the corners of Concubine Zhong's mouth curved slightly.
Queen Yu then looked at Zhao Yuyan and said, "Princess Zhao, the nephew of Concubine Zhong's natal family, the eldest son Zhong Weixing wants to marry you. I wonder if you are willing."
Zhao Yuyan resisted the itching in her throat, and a blush appeared on her pale and weak face: "It all depends on the queen."
"I'm willing..." Queen Yu couldn't help laughing when she heard this.
Concubine Zhong, who was sitting aside, didn't have much joy on her face. Meng Chanyue and Zhao Yuyan walked in together just now. She immediately took a liking to Meng Chanyue, who had a more delicate appearance. As for Zhao Yuyan, who looked sickly, she didn't catch her eyes at all. Unexpectedly, the person her nephew fell in love with turned out to be a sick beauty, which made her unable to be happy.
After receiving Zhao Yuyan's affirmative reply, Queen Yu was in a good mood, and then turned her gaze to Meng Chanyue, who was calm and calm.
"Third Princess, I have two memorials here asking to marry you. One is from the Imperial Master, and the other is from my nephew Yu Boyuan."
As soon as these words came out, everyone in the hall looked at Meng Chanyue.
Meng Chanyue couldn't help clenching her hands hanging by her side. She was not surprised that Zhuang Tuo asked to marry her, but why was there another Yu Boyuan.
Concubine Qian stared at Meng Chanyue for a while and said with a smile: "The third princess of Nanliang is so stunning, no wonder she can attract the Imperial Master and Prince Yu!"
